role: registered v6 fairness-mechanism validation; descriptive, not primary or estimator validation

estimator.note: fixed registered development-family member; it failed whole-estimator selection and is used only to measure allocator/factorial outcomes

paired_trace_contract: Within a world and relay level, every allocator and robustification arm receives the identical raw-arrival map and processing budget. Relay levels share the same exogenous mobility/contact trace and finite transport resources.
transport_scope: finite raw/release buffers, directional contact capacity, copy tokens and reserved release path; receipt return is excluded from this allocator-attribution validation
outcomes: H6 coverage-gap contrast using unchanged 20 percent reduction threshold
H7 worst-group RMSE contrast using unchanged 10 percent reduction threshold
cumulative distinct contributors and population distinct-user debt
all 39 frozen-prefix outcome strata with support retained
paired per-world baseline differences and 2x2x2 factorial effects
claim_rule: Validation is descriptive. Preserve adverse outcomes. Do not launch primary, alter H6/H7 thresholds, select an estimator, or claim starvation freedom.
